narration: Two people save the same share of their pay. One earns triple the other.
caption: दो लोग अपनी कमाई का बराबर हिस्सा बचाते हैं। एक की आमदनी तीन गुना है।
image_brief: Two identical small brass jars standing side by side on a stone windowsill, each holding the same shallow layer of coins, morning light coming in from outside.

narration: They reach financial independence in the same number of years. The income gap changes nothing.
caption: दोनों बराबर सालों में आर्थिक आज़ादी तक पहुँचते हैं। कमाई का अंतर कुछ नहीं बदलता।
image_brief: Two footpaths of different widths meeting at one painted finish line on an empty school ground, flat overcast daylight.

narration: That sounds wrong. Salary is supposed to be the whole story here.
caption: यह ग़लत लगता है। लगता है सैलरी ही सब कुछ तय करती है।
image_brief: A printed salary slip lying alone on a bare wooden table under a single overhead bulb, the total line inked darker than the rest.

narration: It is not. The pot being built does not care what anyone earns.
caption: ऐसा नहीं है। जो फंड बन रहा है, वह कमाई देखता ही नहीं।
image_brief: A large clay water pot on a swept courtyard floor, its mouth open and interior dark, late afternoon sun falling across the rim.

narration: It cares what gets spent. Spending sets the target and eats the deposit.
caption: वह खर्च देखता है। खर्च लक्ष्य तय करता है और बचत भी खा जाता है।
image_brief: A steel bucket on a wet cement floor with a thin stream of water escaping a crack near its base, cool daylight from a high window.

narration: Every rupee spent does damage twice. That double hit is the whole mechanism.
caption: खर्च हुआ हर रुपया दो बार नुक़सान करता है। यही पूरी मशीन है।
image_brief: A single rupee coin resting on the pan of a small kitchen weighing scale that has tipped fully to one side, warm lamp light.

narration: Most raises vanish. The money arrives, and the feeling of being behind stays.
caption: सैलरी बढ़ती है पर पैसा गायब हो जाता है। पीछे रहने का अहसास बना रहता है।
image_brief: An open envelope of banknotes lying on a doormat beside three unopened bills, hallway light spilling from a half-open door.

narration: A bigger salary buys a bigger flat, a longer commute, a bigger phone bill.
caption: बड़ी सैलरी बड़ा घर, लंबा सफ़र और बड़ा फ़ोन बिल ले आती है।
image_brief: A narrow city street seen from a balcony, with a larger flat's tall windows above and a long line of cars below, hazy evening light.

narration: Nothing about that is reckless. Each step looks small and sensible on its own.
caption: इसमें लापरवाही कुछ नहीं है। हर क़दम अलग से समझदारी जैसा लगता है।
image_brief: A grocery bag on a kitchen counter with four small extra items set out beside it, bright noon light through a window grille.

narration: Then the year ends. The bank balance looks exactly like last year's balance.
caption: फिर साल ख़त्म होता है। बैंक बैलेंस पिछले साल जैसा ही दिखता है।
image_brief: A wall calendar with its last page curling, every month crossed through in blue pen, dim room light from one side.

narration: People blame willpower for this. Willpower is not what is happening.
caption: लोग इसे इच्छाशक्ति की कमी कहते हैं। पर असल बात यह नहीं है।
image_brief: A small clay piggy bank standing empty on a wooden shelf with a thin crack along its side, soft evening lamp light.

narration: Arithmetic is. The target moved at the same time as the income did.
caption: मामला गणित का है। आमदनी के साथ-साथ लक्ष्य भी बढ़ गया।
image_brief: A blackboard on an easel in an empty room showing two chalk columns of tally marks of equal height, daylight from tall windows.

narration: Retirement calculators ask for salary first. That question hides the important number.
caption: रिटायरमेंट कैलकुलेटर पहले सैलरी पूछते हैं। यही सवाल असली नंबर छिपा देता है।
image_brief: A pocket calculator lying face up on a glass table with a blank display, hard midday light throwing a sharp shadow.

narration: The important number is the share of take-home pay that never gets spent.
caption: असली नंबर है: हाथ में आई कमाई का वह हिस्सा जो खर्च ही नहीं होता।
image_brief: A steel tiffin box with its lid off on a table, one compartment filled with coins and the others empty, kitchen light.

narration: It has a name. Savings rate. One fraction, and it sets the clock.
caption: इसका नाम है बचत दर। एक अनुपात, और वही घड़ी तय करता है।
image_brief: A glass measuring jug on a counter filled exactly one fifth of the way with water, bright window light behind it.
